name: tenmol
description: React web front-end for the PyMOL engine in this repository (monorepo root).

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names bridge,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "pnpm run dev:bridge" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.test:bridge: bash -c 'if [ -d bridge/tests ]; then bash scripts/dev-bridge.sh --exec python -m pytest bridge/tests -q; else echo "no bridge/tests yet (WP-02 owns them) - skipping"; fi'
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc pnpm-workspace.yaml vitest.workspace.ts "scripts/*.mjs" "apps/**/*" "packages/**/*" docs/webclient/README.md "!**/dist/**" "!**/generated/**" "!**/node_modules/**"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc pnpm-workspace.yaml vitest.workspace.ts "scripts/*.mjs" "apps/**/*" "packages/**/*" docs/webclient/README.md "!**/dist/**" "!**/generated/**" "!**/node_modules/**"
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo *.tsbuildinfo apps/*/dist apps/*/.turbo apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/.turbo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/node_modules node_modules
